articles.title: Heated exchange breaks out in TN Assembly over Rs 5.54 cr tender for shifting CM Office
articles.description: Allegations have surfaced that irregularities took place in the tender issued in connection with shifting the Chief Minister's Office. It is being alleged that the tender notification for the office relocation was published in newspapers on the 13, but was uploaded on the website only four days later, on the 17. It is also alleged that while the tender value was mentioned as Rs 5.54 crore in the newspaper advertisement, the amount was not specified on the website and was instead shown as "NA."
